summary.text: Justin Perry is the Republican candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Bob Duff (D).
A scientist with a Ph.D. from Washington University in St. Louis, he describes himself as a cancer biologist and immunologist.

paragraphs.text: Perry earned a high school diploma from A. J. Dimond High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Cincinnati in 2006, a graduate degree from Fordham University in 2012, and a Ph.D. from Washington University in St. Louis in 2016.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent two decades working on understanding and finding cures for serious diseases, and that he is a husband and father of three boys.
Perry said his campaign emphasizes affordability, and he criticized the Education Cost Sharing formula and state housing mandates as raising costs for localities.
He said he would introduce policy to make Connecticut a science and technology hub, citing Kendall Square in Massachusetts and the Cancer Prevention and Research Institute of Texas as models.
